item.title: Guwahati Gets Northeast India’s Largest Social Gaming Arena ‘Knox’
item.description: Guwahati’s entertainment scene is getting an upgrade with the launch of Knox, a social gaming arena that brings together gaming, food, and music in one space. Located on the 5th floor of Achyut Express Tower on B. Baruah Road, Ulubari, Knox occupies an entire floor spanning over 10,000 sq ft, dedicated to games, food, and social entertainment, making it one of the biggest indoor gaming destinations in Northeast India for teenagers and beyond. item.description: GUWAHATI: The Union government on March 6, Friday, directed the Broadcast Audience Research Council (BARC) to immediately stop publishing Television Rating Points (TRPs) for all television news channels for four weeks or until further notice, citing concerns over sensationalised coverage of the ongoing conflict between Israel and Iran. item.title: Domestic LPG Price up by ₹60, Commercial Cylinders by ₹115 amid West Asia Conflict
item.description: GUWAHATI: Domestic cooking gas prices have been increased across India, with the price of a 14.2-kg household LPG cylinder rising by ₹60, while commercial cylinders have become costlier by around ₹115. item.title: YouTuber Anurag Dobhal Crashes Car at 150 kmph During Instagram Live, Admitted to ICU
item.description: GUWAHATI: Popular YouTuber and Bigg Boss 17 contestant Anurag Dobhal, widely known as UK07 Rider, was hospitalised after crashing his car during an Instagram Live session on Saturday night, March 7.
